source.sanitization: Only timestamp, event, elapsed_ms are retained from matching warning records; auxiliary frontend latency fields are separate and never added to outer dispatch totals.

limitations: Historical v9.121.1 measurement; it does not execute or validate the new Issue #5538 collector.
pane.list records eight running Codex implementation panes in the observed project and a separate PM. The GUI had five Projects; exactly eight agents across the complete GUI is not established.
Fleet state was sampled once per minute. These samples bracket the exact 1800-second log interval; they do not exclude an unobserved transient between samples.
Provider process identities were observed at one point. No pane-to-provider-PID mapping or provider Session IDs were captured; all eight source_session values are none. One pane has no agent_name.
Legacy warnings have no GUI PID or process start time. Correlation is by shared real HOME, log time, and Issue #5385 observation, not a per-record process identity proof.
The legacy timer labels Frontend and MainEventsCleared are broad outer dispatches. Frontend latency detail rows overlap them and must not be summed again.
Legacy records lack pending queue size. Only handlers above 50ms are ranked; p95_slow_ms describes that filtered population, not all dispatches.
Six slow outer dispatch kinds were observed. Four additional kinds are not invented to fill the requested top-ten limit.
